text: There is a huge pothole on MG Road near City Mall. Multiple vehicles have been damaged and one person was injured yesterday.
MG Road ke paas ek bada gaddha hai, gaadi ka tyre phat gaya. Bahut khatarnak hai.
No water supply in Sector 15 for the last 3 days. We are buying tanker water at high cost. Please help.
Sector 15 mein paani nahi aa raha hai, teen din se supply band hai. Tanker mangana pad raha hai.
Power outage in Andheri West since last night. Transformer seems to have burst. No electricity for 14 hours.
Andheri West mein bijli nahi hai kal raat se. Transformer fatt gaya lagta hai.
Fire broke out in the slum area near Dharavi. Three shanties have been completely destroyed. Fire brigade has not arrived yet.
Dharavi ke jhopdi mein aag lag gayi hai! Teen ghar jal gaye hain. Fire brigade ko bulao jaldi!
Garbage has not been collected from our lane in Malad for over a week. The entire street smells terrible and there are stray dogs everywhere.
Street lights on Marine Drive promenade have been off for 5 days. It is very dark and unsafe for evening walkers.
Open manhole near Juhu beach entrance. Very dangerous, especially at night. A child almost fell in yesterday.
Sewage water overflowing into the main road at Kurla station area. Very unhygienic conditions. People are falling sick.
The government hospital in Borivali has no stock of basic medicines. Patients are being turned away.
Illegal construction happening on the footpath near Dadar station. Shopkeepers have encroached the entire walkway.
Bus number 467 route has been cancelled without any notice. Hundreds of daily commuters are stranded.
Chemical factory in Thane is releasing toxic fumes. Many residents in the nearby colony are complaining of breathing problems.
Primary school in Vikhroli has a damaged roof. During rains, water leaks into classrooms. Children are at risk.
Exposed electrical wires hanging low near the children's park in Goregaon. Very dangerous for kids.
Water pipeline burst on SV Road, Bandra. Water is gushing out and the road is flooded.
Stray dog menace in Powai. A pack of dogs attacked a delivery boy last night. Need animal control.
Traffic signal at Haji Ali junction not working for 3 days. Causing massive traffic jams during peak hours.
No dustbins in the newly developed Lodha Township area. Residents are dumping garbage in empty plots.
Bridge near Elphinstone Road station has developed cracks. It sways during rush hour. Could collapse any time.
Dengue outbreak in Chembur. Multiple families affected. Need fumigation and medical camp urgently.
Auto-rickshaw drivers refusing to go by meter in Thane station area. Charging double fare.
Noise pollution from a wedding hall in Vile Parle every night until 2 AM. Violating noise regulations.
BEST bus stop shelter collapsed during last night's storm. Broken glass everywhere on the footpath.
Illegal tree cutting happening in Aarey Colony. About 50 trees have been chopped down already.
Electric meter reading is wrong. Bill shows 5x normal usage. Nobody from the electricity board is responding.
Sewer gas smell coming from the drain near Mulund check naka. People are feeling nauseous.
Building collapse in Bhiwandi! Two floors have come down. People may be trapped inside. Please send help immediately!
Parking mafia charging illegal fees in Colaba market area. No official receipt given.
Government school in Dharavi has no functioning toilets. Students, especially girls, are suffering.
Water tanker mafia operating in Vasai. Diverting municipal water supply and selling it privately.
Speed breaker too high on residential road in Khandala. Ambulance got stuck yesterday. Medical emergency delayed.
Metro construction debris blocking the main road in Ghatkopar. Dust is causing respiratory issues.
Contaminated water coming from taps in Kalyan East. Water is yellowish and smells bad. Children are falling ill.
Public park in Bhandup has been taken over by drug addicts. Used syringes found on the ground. Very unsafe for children.
Footpath completely broken near Sion hospital. Wheelchair patients cannot access the main entrance.
Gas leak reported from a restaurant kitchen on Hill Road, Bandra. Strong smell spreading across the street.
Yahan Malad mein kuda uthaya nahi gaya poore hafte se. Bahut badbu aa rahi hai aur macchar badh gaye hain.
Scholarship application portal for SC/ST students has been down for 2 weeks. Last date is approaching.
New residential building in Mira Road being constructed without proper permits. No safety net around the site.
Lake in Powai is turning green due to untreated sewage being discharged. Fish are dying.
Ambulance took 45 minutes to arrive in Navi Mumbai despite the hospital being 3 km away. Unacceptable delay.
